patch.value: Handle SDK CompletionTimestampResolution unresolved arm and upgrade pm-cli pin to 2026.8.3

Under @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.8.3 the SDK type CompletionTimestampResolution is a union that includes an UnresolvedCompletionTimestamp arm (resolved false), so src/generator.ts no longer typechecks: the ObservedSdkCompletion widening assumed every resolution was resolved (TS2322 at generator.ts line 1831). Handle the unresolved arm explicitly: an item whose completion timestamp cannot be resolved must not silently acquire a wrong changelog date; it keeps the existing created_at final fallback and otherwise stays unplaceable by time (source none), matching how filterItemsByTime treats missing dates. Also bump the dev pin to caret 2026.8.3 and the peer floor to 2026.8.3, refresh the lockfile, and add a regression test covering the unresolved arm.

npm run typecheck passes against @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.8.3 with the unresolved arm handled via the resolved discriminant; no fabricated date for unresolved items; new test covers the unresolved arm; package.json pins dev caret 2026.8.3 and peer floor 2026.8.3 with lockfile committed; npm run build, npm test, npm run coverage, npm run docstring and npm run changelog:check all pass

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Investigated the FlagDefinition type-surface change in @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.8.3. Read node_modules/@unbrained/pm-cli/dist/core/extensions/extension-types.d.ts: FlagDefinition is now a CLOSED interface (no index signature) with fields long, short, value_name, description, required, enabled, visible, value_type, type (deprecated), list, repeatable, default. There is NO aliases field — alias support for extension-declared flags was genuinely dropped. The host-side CliFlagContract (sdk/cli-contracts/flag-contracts.d.ts) still carries aliases?: string[], so hostOwnedFlagSet() reading contract.aliases stays correct.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Fixed test/host-flag-contracts.test.ts: removed the dead flag.aliases read and the stale 'open shape' comment from collectDeclaredFlags; removed the now-unused FlagDefinition import; narrowed DeclaredFlag to just {command, long?, short?}; updated findHostFlagCollision to compare only long/short spellings (dropping aliases) and rewrote its docstring so the gate no longer claims to check a spelling the host no longer lets an extension declare. No 'as any' / index-signature cast — the loop reads flag.long/flag.short directly off the declared FlagDefinition type.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Also fixed a pre-existing, environment-sensitive test failure exposed while running the gate suite: two tests in test/generator.test.ts did 'pm create --status closed' without a closing summary. governance_require_close_reason defaults to enabled (confirmed via 'pm config global get' showing policy: enabled, changed: false), so both creates were rejected with close_reason_required even on clean main (verified by stashing all working-tree changes and re-running). Added a --message closing summary to each create call (lines ~2147 and ~2263); this satisfies governance without weakening the assertions those tests exist to make (install-smoke and node-CLI-entrypoint routing). All 248 tests pass.

value.author: claude-code
value.text:
Review round 1 fixes applied (Claude, taking over after pi-agent completed and exited).

Greptile P1 (host version floor remains stale) — correct and accepted. manifest.json declared pm_min_version 2026.7.24 while the code now branches on the 2026.8.3 CompletionTimestampResolution resolved discriminant. peerDependencies had been bumped to >=2026.8.3, but the manifest floor is what the extension HOST enforces at activation, so on any host from 2026.7.24 through 2026.8.2 the extension would still activate, see an undefined resolved field, take the unresolved arm, and silently mis-date or omit completed items from the changelog. Floor bumped to 2026.8.3.

Checked whether this was fleet-wide: pm-beads, pm-csv and pm-github also carry pm_min_version (2026.7.28) with a >=2026.8.3 peer range, but their changes (create-then-close routing) are backward compatible — pm close --reason and --completed-at both predate 2026.8.3 — so their floors are not stale in the same sense and were deliberately left alone. pm-graph and pm-web declare pm.compatibility v2 with no version floor and are unaffected.

CodeRabbit minor (add bounded-window assertions) — correct and accepted. Both new tests set date but no since/until, and explainChangelogSelection only filters by time when a bound is present, so the tests asserted how an item was LABELLED without proving the behaviour that labelling is supposed to guarantee. Added: the unresolved item is asserted absent from a bounded window, and the created_at legacy record is asserted present in a window containing its created_at and absent from one that does not.

Gates after the fixes: typecheck clean, 248/248 tests pass, coverage thresholds met, changelog:check up to date.

patch.value: Generator tracks the 2026.8.3 SDK union without fabricating dates; host-flag gate narrowed to what it enforces; manifest activation floor raised to 2026.8.3 to match the SDK shape the code requires.

pm-changelog compiles and passes its full suite, docstring gate and coverage thresholds against the 2026.8.3 SDK, never fabricates a completion date, and cannot be activated by a host too old for the SDK shape it depends on.

Achieved. 248/248 tests pass, docstring gate clean, coverage thresholds met, changelog:check up to date. Bounded-window assertions added so the tests prove the behaviour rather than only the provenance labelling. Merged as unbraind/pm-changelog#121.

Merged in unbraind/pm-changelog#121. resolveCompletionTimestamp now returns the CompletionTimestampResolution discriminated union in pm-cli 2026.8.3, so the generator branches on the resolved discriminant and the unresolved arm never fabricates a date: created_at still places legacy records as an inferred attribution, and an item with no timestamp of any kind is reported as source none rather than being silently dated. FlagDefinition is no longer an open shape, so the dead flag.aliases read and its stale comment were removed and the host-flag gate narrowed to the spellings it actually enforces. Review found one further real defect: manifest.json still declared pm_min_version 2026.7.24, the floor the extension host enforces at activation, so a 2026.7.24-2026.8.2 host would have activated this build and silently mis-dated or dropped completed items. Independently verified by Claude: typecheck clean, 248/248 tests, docstring gate clean, coverage thresholds met.
